description: Returns the main WSF ferry routes operating on a given date, each with the directed terminal pairs it serves that day (terminalPairs) — departing and arriving terminal IDs and names, which are exactly the pairs wsdot_get_ferry_schedule accepts for that date. Route IDs correspond to impactedRouteIds in ferry alerts from wsdot_get_ferry_alerts, though some alert route IDs (seasonal, San Juan interisland, or Sidney B.C.) may not appear in this list. For the full terminal list with coordinates, use wsdot_get_ferry_terminals.

tripDate.description: Date for which to list routes, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today if omitted.

name: wsdot_get_ferry_routes

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `api_unavailable`: WSF Ferry API is unreachable or returns a non-2xx response after retries. `invalid_access_code`: WSF rejected the request because WSDOT_ACCESS_CODE is missing, invalid, or not registered. `invalid_date`: The tripDate is not a valid YYYY-MM-DD date, or WSF rejects it as outside the dates it has published a schedule for. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Optional notice when no routes are available for the date. Absent on normal results.

routes.description: Ferry routes operating on the requested date.

items.description: A WSF ferry route operating on the requested date.

routeId.description: Numeric route identifier. Corresponds to impactedRouteIds in ferry alerts.

terminalPairs.description: Directed terminal pairs this route serves on the requested date; empty when it serves none. Absent only when upstream omits the route ID the lookup needs.

items.description: One direction of service between two terminals on the requested date.

arrivingTerminalId.description: Arriving terminal ID — the arrivingTerminalId to pass to wsdot_get_ferry_schedule.

arrivingTerminalName.description: Arriving terminal name. Absent when upstream omits it.

departingTerminalId.description: Departing terminal ID — the departingTerminalId to pass to wsdot_get_ferry_schedule.

departingTerminalName.description: Departing terminal name. Absent when upstream omits it.

tripDate.description: Date for which routes were retrieved (ISO 8601).

title: Get Ferry Routes
